description: Send a message about a bounty, service booking, feedback, dispute, or support. Direct-message threads are read-only. First, check `messaging` in `get_conversation`. If `canSend` is false, `reason` explains why and what to do next. Sending anyway returns an error with a message for the sender: 400 for `archived`, 409 `conversation_read_only` for `not_selected`, 403 `CHAT_LOCKED_UNTIL_HIRE` for `hire_required`, and 403 `system_channel_read_only` for `system_channel`. Keep contact details, links, and payments on RentAHuman. Use an `idempotencyKey` to retry safely: sending the same key again returns the first result.

agentName.description: Ignored; messages show the conversation's agent name.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to send a message to

credentials.description: Signed credentials from get_agent_identity (recommended for verified identity)

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when signature was created

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key, kept for 24 hours. Reusing it returns the original successful result instead of sending a duplicate message.
